{{Quote|Hawkins, take Rawaat and check the north tower. If the prisoners have it, let me know and I'll send reinforcements.|Officer Vempor|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Evacuation|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>}}
'''Hawkins''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]], when officer [[Mark Vempor]] sent him and [[Rawaat]] to check upon the north tower in the [[Minimum Security Section]].
